Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1211
Claimant:
Kevin Stanley
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
11-26-24
Claim reported by the policyholder's driver after a low-speed collision in a parking lot. The driver is named on the
policy, and the police report confirms the clamiant was in the vehicle at the scene.
12-7-24
Claimant reports a wrist fracture and says the impact came from the driver's side while the car was reversing.
Claimant states two passengers were in the car at the time.
1-17-25
Photos of the vehicle were received. They show damage consistent with a collision, but no independent witnesses
have come forward and the scene is not otherwise documented.
1-23-25
Medical records show a wrist fracture consistent with the kind and force of a collision of this type. The claimant also
disclsoed a minor strain to the same area several years ago, which healed fully.
3-30-25
Claimant gave a second statement. The direction of impact is now described as coming from the front, and the
claimant now says one passenger was in the car, not two. No prior damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing
suggests the damage predates the policy start date.
4-2-25
Inspection notes the dents sit on the passenger side and at a higher point on the body than the impact the claimant
describes. This does not match the account given so far, and the discrepancy is being reviewed with the appraiser.
4-17-25
Treatment followed a usual course and tapered as the claimant improved. The file is being held pending the
reconciliation of the statements and the inspection findings.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
